prompt: A fruit arrangement in a wicker basket. The basket holds three shiny red apples. A green pear is positioned between two of the apples. A banana, which is longer than the pear, is curved around it. There is also a cluster of blueberries, and their number is double the number of apples. Also in the basket are some strawberries, and their number is two less than the number of blueberries. A bunch of purple grapes hangs over the banana. A slice of watermelon is under the grapes, and the watermelon slice is wider than the bunch of grapes. A kiwi, cut in half, is beside the blueberries. One of the apples is leaning against the pear, and the grapes are touching the banana.
